{{Japanese name}} {{PrevNext |prev=YUU |next=CUTIE SPHERE |list=Japanese ending themes |colorscheme=ZA}} {{Song |type=HZ ED 06 |language=ja |title=ねてもさめても |transliterated=Netemo Sametemo |translated=Asleep or Awake |screen=hd |screenshot=HZ ED 06.png |artistname=ポルカドットスティングレイ |artistname_ro=[[Polkadot Stingray]] |lyricistname=雫 |lyricistname_ro=Shizuku |composername=雫 |composername_ro=Shizuku |arrangername=ポルカドットスティングレイ |arrangername_ro=Polkadot Stingray |albumtype=album |albumtitle=逆鱗 |albumtitle_ro=[[Imperial Wrath]] |catalognumber=UMCK-7290, PDCS-1939, UMCK-1808 |recordcompany=UNIVERSAL SIGMA |colorscheme=ZA}} '''Asleep or Awake''' (Japanese: '''ねてもさめても''' ''Netemo Sametemo'') is the Japanese ending theme for the ''[[Rising Again]]'' arc and the sixth of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. It debuted as an ending song in [[HZ115]], replacing [[YUU]]. The full version of the song was first released digitally on October 31, 2025. ==Ending animation== ===Synopsis=== At sunset, the [[Brave Olivine]] flies as [[Liko]] and {{TP|Liko|Meowscarada}} walk on the bridge. A series of images appear one by one – [[Roy]] exchanging fist bumps with {{TP|Roy|Skeledirge}}, [[Dot]] and {{TP|Dot|Quaquaval}} looking at the former's [[Rotom Phone]], [[Ult]] and {{p|Sableye}} keeping each other in check, Liko sitting on a swing under a tree with Meowscarada and [[Pagogo]], and Meowscarada, Skeledirge, Quaquaval, {{p|Dragonite}}, and [[Captain Pikachu]] jumping together on the wing deck. On a yellow background with rotating {{i|Poké Ball}} symbols, a Poké Ball flies into view before showing Roy tossing it in the air repeatedly and looking to the side while walking alongside Skeledirge toward the camera against an orange background. Dot and Quaquaval walk backwards against a purple background. Ult and Sableye look for something against a green background before jumping off-screen. Liko and Meowscarada face forward while walking together against a blue background. Liko has {{p|Hattrem}} in her hands before the scene changes to Liko and {{TP|Liko|Hatterene}} embracing each other. On the wing deck during the day time, [[Mollie]] looks after {{p|Snorunt}} while {{TP|Mollie|Chansey}}, {{p|Maushold}}, [[Ludlow]], {{p|Quagsire}}, {{p|Pawmi}}, and {{rf|Alolan}} {{p|Muk}} watches, with {{p|Rayquaza}}'s shadow casting from above. {{p|Gimmighoul}} rests on Dot's head while she holds a [[Gimmighoul Coin]], which changes to her being carried by {{TP|Dot|Gholdengo}}. At night, on the wing deck, [[Orla]] sits with {{p|Metagross}} and {{p|Elekid}} while {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}} leans against [[Murdock]], who is lying on {{TP|Murdock|Lycanroc}}, all of them looking at the sky. The screen splits into four sections featuring the younger members of the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]] performing the same actions, overlaid with the same colors as the backgrounds from earlier. Cap runs in a straight line across the bottom of the screen from right to left, then across the top from left to right in the opposite direction, before transitioning to running up [[Friede]]'s arm. Roy and {{TP|Roy|Lucario}} stand back to back before showing the former with [[Mega Evolution|Mega Lucario Z]]. [[Amethio]] is gazing into the distance with {{TP|Amethio|Ceruledge}} by his side at night. Liko shares a hug with {{p|Charcadet}} before changing to her posing with {{TP|Liko|Armarouge}}. Meowscarada stands next to Liko, showing the younger members and their Pokémon have assembled together on the bridge. The four {{pkmn|Trainer}}s exchange looks before turning to see Friede and Cap smiling at them, which Liko returns with one of her own. ===Characters=== ====Human==== * [[Liko]] * [[Roy]] * [[Friede]] * [[Orla]] * [[Ludlow]] * [[Murdock]] * [[Mollie]] * [[Dot]] * [[Ult]] * [[Amethio]] ====Pokémon==== * {{p|Meowscarada}} ({{OP|Liko|Meowscarada}}) * {{p|Hattrem}} ({{OP|Liko|Hattrem}}) * {{p|Hatterene}} ({{OP|Liko|Hatterene}}; [[HZ118]] - [[HZ135]]) * {{p|Terapagos}} ([[Liko]]'s; [[Pagogo]]; {{form|Terapagos|Normal Form}}) * {{p|Charcadet}} ({{OP|Liko|Charcadet}}) * {{p|Armarouge}} ({{OP|Liko|Armarouge}}; [[HZ124]] - [[HZ135]]) * {{p|Crocalor}} ({{OP|Roy|Skeledirge}}'s; [[HZ115]] - [[HZ118]]) * {{p|Skeledirge}} ({{OP|Roy|Skeledirge}}'s; [[HZ119]] - [[HZ135]]) * {{p|Lucario}} ({{OP|Roy|Lucario}}; {{Shiny}}; [[Mega Evolution|Mega Lucario Z]]) * {{p|Pikachu}} ([[Friede]]'s; [[Captain Pikachu]]) * {{p|Metagross}} ([[Orla]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Orla]]'s) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Ludlow]]'s) * {{p|Lycanroc}} ({{OP|Murdock|Rockruff|Lycanroc}}; {{form|Lycanroc|Midday Form}}) * {{p|Alcremie}} ({{OP|Murdock|Alcremie}}; {{form|Alcremie|Strawberry Ruby Swirl}}) * {{p|Chansey}} ({{OP|Mollie|Chansey}}) * {{p|Maushold}} ([[Mollie]]'s; {{form|Maushold|Family of Four}}) * {{p|Quaxwell}} ({{OP|Dot|Quaxwell}}; [[HZ115]] - [[HZ127]]) * {{p|Quaquaval}} ({{OP|Dot|Quaquaval}}; [[HZ128]] - [[HZ135]]) * {{p|Gimmighoul}} ({{OP|Dot|Gimmighoul}}; {{form|Gimmighoul|Chest Form}}) * {{p|Gholdengo}} ({{OP|Dot|Gimmighoul}}; [[HZ120]] - [[HZ135]]) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Dot]]'s; [[Rotom Phone]]) * {{p|Sableye}} ([[Ult]]'s) * {{p|Dragonite}} ([[Ult]]'s) * {{p|Ceruledge}} ({{OP|Amethio|Ceruledge}}) * {{p|Pawmi}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Snorunt}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]') * {{p|Muk}} ([[Rising Volt Tacklers]]'; [[Alolan form]]) ==Lyrics== ===TV size=== {{Schemetable|ZA}} !
